# Command-syntax teaching corpus — sources

Public MATLAB-language teaching/course scripts, saved byte-exact as published (blob SHA-1 below matches
`git hash-object` of the file; CRLF/LF kept). Used only as parse input by `tool/parse-corpus.sh`.
All licences are GPL-3.0-compatible (MIT, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0, GPL-3.0). No MathWorks material.
Collected 2026-11-17. URLs are permalinks to the commit the file was taken from.
